content: Telotristat ethyl is indicated for use in combination with somatostatin analog (SSA) therapy in adults who are inadequately controlled by SSA therapy alone. The recommended dosage is 250 mg orally three times daily. However, its safety and efficacy in this context have not been fully established. Telotristat ethyl interacts with various drugs by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism, leading to decreased plasma levels or effects of these drugs. This can result in reduced efficacy or potential therapeutic failure. Below are specific interactions and recommendations for coadministration: 1. Doravirine: Telotristat ethyl decreases doravirine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated due to the risk of virologic failure and resistance development. 2. Lonafarnib: Telotristat ethyl reduces lonafarnib levels, a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate. Coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is contraindicated. 3. Mavacamten: Telotristat ethyl decreases mavacamten levels. Coadministration is contraindicated. 4. Avapritinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces avapritinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 5. Capivasertib: Telotristat ethyl decreases capivasertib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers reduce capivasertib exposure, potentially compromising efficacy. 6. Daridorexant: Telotristat ethyl reduces daridorexant levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 7. Elacestrant: Telotristat ethyl decreases elacestrant levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 8. Entrectinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces entrectinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 9. Fedratinib: Telotristat ethyl decreases fedratinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. The effect of moderate CYP3A4 inducers on fedratinib has not been studied. 10. Fineranone: Telotristat ethyl reduces fineranone levels via CYP2E1 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 11. Fruquintinib: Telotristat ethyl increases fruquintinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, continue fruquintinib at the recommended dosage. 12. Infigratinib (DSC): Telotristat ethyl decreases infigratinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 13. Lefamulin: Telotristat ethyl reduces lefamulin levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Monitor for reduced efficacy if coadministration is necessary. 14. Lemborexant: Telotristat ethyl decreases lemborexant levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 15. Lenacapavir: Telotristat ethyl reduces lenacapavir levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 16. Leniolisib: Telotristat ethyl decreases leniolisib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 17. Lorlatinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces lorlatinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, monitor liver function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin). 18. Lumateperone: Telotristat ethyl decreases lumateperone levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 19. Lurbinectedin: Telotristat ethyl reduces lurbinectedin levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 20. Nirogacestat: Telotristat ethyl decreases nirogacestat levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 21. Olutasidenib: Telotristat ethyl reduces olutasidenib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers decrease olutasidenib plasma concentrations and efficacy. 22. Omaflexolone: Telotristat ethyl decreases omaflexolone levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 23. Palovarotene: Telotristat ethyl reduces palovarotene levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 24. Pimigatinib: Telotristat ethyl decreases pimigatinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 25. Pirtobrutinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces pirtobrutinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, increase pirtobrutinib dosage as recommended. 26. Praziquantel: Telotristat ethyl decreases praziquantel levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 27. Pretomanid: Telotristat ethyl reduces pretomanid levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Pretomanid is a CYP3A4 substrate, and coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is contraindicated. 28. Quizartinib: Telotristat ethyl decreases quizartinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 29. Repotrectinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces repotrectinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 30. Rimegepant: Telotristat ethyl decreases rimegepant levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 31. Selumetinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces selumetinib levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 32. Siponimod: Telotristat ethyl decreases siponimod levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Coadministration with moderate CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 inducers is not recommended for certain genotypes. 33. Tazemetostat: Telotristat ethyl reduces tazemetostat levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 34. Voclosporin: Telotristat ethyl decreases voclosporin levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 35. Zuranolone: Telotristat ethyl reduces zuranolone levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 36. Alfentanil: Telotristat ethyl decreases alfentanil levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 37. Alpelisib: Telotristat ethyl reduces alpelisib levels. Use caution and monitor. 38. Atogepant: Telotristat ethyl decreases atogepant levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust atogepant dosage as recommended. 39. Belumosudil: Telotristat ethyl reduces belumosudil levels. Use caution and monitor. 40. Buprenorphine (subdermal implant): Telotristat ethyl decreases buprenorphine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Monitor for withdrawal symptoms and consider alternative formulations if necessary. 41. Buprenorphine (long-acting injection): Telotristat ethyl reduces buprenorphine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Ensure adequate plasma levels and consider transitioning to adjustable formulations if needed. 42. Bupropion: Telotristat ethyl decreases bupropion levels via CYP2B6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Dosage adjustments may be necessary. 43. Carbamazepine: Telotristat ethyl reduces carbamazepine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 44. Clonidine: Telotristat ethyl decreases clonidine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 45. Colchicine: Telotristat ethyl reduces colchicine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 46. Cyclosporine: Telotristat ethyl decreases cyclosporine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 47. Diazepam (buccal/intranasal): Telotristat ethyl may alter diazepam elimination. Use caution and monitor. 48. Dihydroergotamine: Telotristat ethyl reduces dihydroergotamine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 49. Disopyramide: Telotristat ethyl decreases disopyramide levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 50. Efavirenz: Telotristat ethyl reduces efavirenz levels via CYP2B6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 51. Elagolix: Telotristat ethyl decreases elagolix levels. Use caution and monitor. 52. Erdafitinib: Telotristat ethyl reduces erdafitinib levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust dosage based on serum phosphate levels and tolerability. 53. Ergotamine: Telotristat ethyl decreases ergotamine levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 54. Ethosuximide: Telotristat ethyl reduces ethosuximide levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 55. Everolimus: Telotristat ethyl decreases everolimus levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 56. Fentanyl: Telotristat ethyl reduces fentanyl levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 57. Isavuconazonium sulfate: Telotristat ethyl decreases isavuconazonium sulfate levels. Use caution and monitor. 58. Levamlodipine: Telotristat ethyl reduces levamlodipine levels. Use caution and monitor. Monitor blood pressure closely. This list highlights the importance of monitoring and adjusting therapy when telotristat ethyl is coadministered with drugs metabolized by CYP3A4 or CYP2B6 enzymes.
